data.name: Razeelah
data.gender_notes: Razeelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Razeelah is a Quranic name, derived from the Arabic word 'Razi' which means 'exalted'. It implies an exalted and high position in the society. The name Razeelah carries the meaning “Lord is Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Razeelah usually hope their child will grow to embody lord is exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is spiritually significant as it indicates that the person bearing this name will be highly respected and honored in the community.
data.etymology: Razeelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord is Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razeelah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رازِيلَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم جميل، ذو معنى ملائكي، يعني راز من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسمُ رَازِيلَة، اسمٌ عربيٌّ أصيلٌ، يُنْسبُ إلى الْمَلائِكةِ، وُردتْ في بعضِ المصادرِ أنَّ معنىٰ الاسمِ رازٌ من الله، وَتُعْرَفُ بِجمالِ نَسْخِهَا وِعَزَّمةِ مَعنَاهَا، وَتُستخدمُ كَأَسْمٍ لِبناتِ المسلمين في أنحاءِ العالمِ الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: رازِِیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورت نام، معنی ملائِکوی، یعنی اللہ کا راز
in_urdu.long_meaning: رازِِیلہ، یہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو ملائِکوں سے منسوب ہے، اور اس کا معنی اللہ کا راز سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اپنی خوبصورتی اور مہک کے لیے بھی جانا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام پاکستان، بھارت اور دیگر مسلم ممالک میں بेटیاں رکھنے کے لیے عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: राज़ीलह
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदर नाम, मिश्रित अर्थ, अल्लाह का रहस्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: राज़ीलह एक सुन्दर श्रृंगार नाम है जो मلائिकों से जुड़ा है। इसका अर्थ बताया जाता है 'अल्लाह का रहस्य'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समाज में बेटियों के लिए लोकप्रिय है।

The name is admired for its beauty and elegance. It's a popular choice for baby girls in Muslim communities worldwide, reflecting the reverence for Allah and the desire for blessings.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Razeelah holds great significance in Islamic tradition. The name Razeelah is derived from the Arabic word 'Razi', which translates to 'exalted' or 'sublime'. In the Quran, Allah refers to the believers who have attained a high position in paradise as 'Ruh al-Quddus', meaning the 'saints' or 'sublime' souls. The name Razeelah can be seen as a reminder of the aspiration towards spiritual exaltation and purity, as well as a reminder of the ultimate goal of following the teachings of Islam: to attain closeness to Allah and eternal bliss in paradise.
